title: CobbleHelx Relics
description: The Core Mod created by Two Way that features Helx Universe items and blocks.

# CobbleHelx Relics 
![COBBLEHELX Title Graphic. It has blue hues along the letters with pink butterfly accents.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2ced94ddf952fa1d8d47ec1f20c3741bc78cfd5.png)
## Welcome to the Helx Universe.

### Features
![New Ores](https://img.shields.io/badge/New_Ores-5B6C7A?style=for-the-badge)  ![Custom Armor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Custom_Armor-5B6C7A?style=for-the-badge)  ![Magic Relics](https://img.shields.io/badge/Magic_Relics-5B6C7A?style=for-the-badge)  ![World Generation](https://img.shields.io/badge/World_Generation-5B6C7A?style=for-the-badge)  ![85+ Paintings](https://img.shields.io/badge/85%2B_Paintings-5B6C7A?style=for-the-badge)  ![Decorative Blocks](https://img.shields.io/badge/Decorative_Blocks-5B6C7A?style=for-the-badge)
### Environment
![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric_Only-1.21.1-0077ff?style=for-the-badge)  ![Server Friendly](https://img.shields.io/badge/Server_Friendly-Yes-0077ff?style=for-the-badge)  ![Singleplayer](https://img.shields.io/badge/Singleplayer-Yes-0077ff?style=for-the-badge)
<details>
<summary>Note for Server Owners</summary>
While natural acquisition of the Chrysalis Relyx gem is implemented, we suggest server owners to integrate the gem into progression systems using mods such as:

- bounty/reward boards
- quest mods
- loot tables
- custom NPC rewards
- shops and economies

By default it's a rare resource, until we add a config to up the world gen rate.

```
cobblehelxrelics:chrysalis_relyx
```
</details>

### Dependencies
![None Needed](https://img.shields.io/badge/NONE_NEEDED-100%_Standalone-0077ff?style=for-the-badge)
## Documentation and Get In Touch
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join_Discord-Two_Way_EU-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://two-way.eu/discord)
[![Wiki](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod_Wiki-2E8B57?style=for-the-badge&logo=bookstack&logoColor=white)](https://publish.obsidian.md/helx/_GameServers/Minecraft/Cobblemon/CobbleHelx+Relics+(MOD))

## Description

**CobbleHelx Relics** expands Minecraft with new ores, decorative blocks, glowing trees, magical relics, tools, armor, music and paintings inspired by the Helx Universe.

Explore for Chrysalis Relyx, discover rare resources, transform blocks with item drop mechanics, and build with dozens of unique decorative materials designed for survival worlds, Cobblemon servers, and creative builders alike.

[**Check out the gallery!**
](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblehelx-relics/gallery)

![A pixel-art texture sheet showing a collection of items made for this mod. It's seperated into 2 rows and is mostly blue, pink, teal and purple.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8dafec5268109b402cc3f181c16607cb8898b58.png)

### About Helx
Helx is a fictional universe created for projects by Two Way Europe, our non-profit organisation. It serves as the foundation for the stories, lore, regions, items, mechanics, and multiplayer experiences featured across our projects and related creations.
[**More info Two Way Europe can be found here**](https://two-way.eu/).

## Why would you install Cobblehelx Relics?
- New ores and world generation
- Two custom tree species with glowing wood
- Decorative blocks and building materials
- Chrysalis Relyx tools and armor
- Magical relic crafting and world transformation mechanics
- 85+ custom paintings
- Multiplayer-friendly progression
- Built for Cobblemon but works standalone

## Chrysalis Relyx Equipment
Chrysalis Relyx armor set with an armor set effect, custom tools, future upgrades and enhancements.

## Magical Transformations

### Magic Relic Block

![Image shows that a chrysalis relyx can be dropped on the Magic Relyc Block to get a RuneCarver](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a7b36e5b41f6f6d3767f8e68ac8eaa19c3d3dde_0.webp)

The Magic Relic Block allows certain items to be transformed by dropping them onto the block.
<details>
<summary>MRB Transformables</summary>

- Chrysalis Relyx ➜ Runecarver
- Glow Berries ➜ Pur Berries
- Stone ➜ Helx Infused Stone
- End Stone ➜ Helx Web Infused Stone
- Dormant Helx Upgrade Smithing Template ➜ Helx Upgrade Smithing Template

</details>

### The RuneCarver
The Runecarver can be used to right click rune blocks to change them into other variants.
It can also be used to cycle through the majority of decorative blocks.
<details>
<summary>RuneCarver cycle chains</summary>

Chrysalis Relyx Rune Chain
- Chrysalis Relyx Block ➜ Chrysalis Relyx Rune Block
- Chrysalis Relyx Rune Block ➜ Chrysalis Relyx Rune Butterfly Block
- Chrysalis Relyx Rune Butterfly Block ➜ Chrysalis Relyx Rune Meerkat Block
- Chrysalis Relyx Rune Meerkat Block ➜ Chrysalis Relyx Rune Hexagon Block
- Chrysalis Relyx Rune Hexagon Block ➜ Chrysalis Relyx Rune Block

Deepslate Rune Chain
- Chiseled Deepslate ➜ Deepslate Rune Butterfly Block
- Deepslate Rune Butterfly Block ➜ Deepslate Rune Meerkat Block
- Deepslate Rune Meerkat Block ➜ Chiseled Deepslate

Red Sandstone Rune Chain
- Chiseled Red Sandstone ➜ Red Sandstone Rune Butterfly Block
- Red Sandstone Rune Butterfly Block ➜ Red Sandstone Rune Meerkat Block
- Red Sandstone Rune Meerkat Block ➜ Chiseled Red Sandstone

Eospark Plank Cycle
- Eosrune Horizontal Planks ➜ Eosrune Vertical Planks
- Eosrune Vertical Planks ➜ Eosrune Quarter Planks
- Eosrune Quarter Planks ➜ Eosrune Small Quarter Planks
- Eosrune Small Quarter Planks ➜ Eosrune Horizontal Planks

Jakaspark Plank Cycle
- Jakaspark Horizontal Planks ➜ Jakaspark Vertical Planks
- Jakaspark Vertical Planks ➜ Jakaspark Quarter Planks
- Jakaspark Quarter Planks ➜ Jakaspark Small Quarter Planks
- Jakaspark Small Quarter Planks ➜ Jakaspark Horizontal Planks

</details>

### ???
There's more world tranformation crafting recipes planned. 
But I can't tell you too much about them, right now.

## Explore New Natural Features

![Pixel art of the Eospark and Jakarune Tree. OPne is brown and yellow with teal leaves, the other is purple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ddf68912cd57f6713eea22905a2c14d08eaa4ad.png)

### Jakarune Trees
Found in Cherry Groves
### Eospark Trees
Found in Savannas and Eroded Badlands
### Suri Crystal Outcrops
Rare crystal formations appearing naturally in the world.
### Chrysalis Relyx Ore
A valuable resource found underground.
<details>
<summary>Where Do I Find Ores?</summary>
Generates 14 veins of 1-2 between -70 and 320 in stone and deepslate in the overworld.
</details>


## Roadmap

<details>
